scope: Bounded production RAII scope static-state audit, not a complete Blink global-state audit
excluded: method names returning TreeScope or WorkerGlobalScope are not static scope state
ownership_rationale: Pointers refer to native renderer stack/DOM owner; counters and active flags must follow matching per-renderer state. Delayed-clamp pending vector already uses Persistent singleton ownership. XML callback globals use libxml thread state; only Blink current_document pointer changed. No SDK or global POSIX changes.
